plugins.name: xcalibur
plugins.description: A coachable OODA loop for any experiment-driven work: you coach, Claude shows its reasoning at checkpoints (pre-registered predictions and falsifiers, noise floors, after-action reviews) and keeps your feedback in an append-only lessons file it reads every session. Plus a GPU inference/kernel speedup campaign skill with paired ABBA timing, A/A margins, screen-then-confirm, numerics gates and GPU discipline.
